entities.name: The Sylex (as named in Return to Dominaria Ep. 9)
Death of Belzenlok at the Cabal Stronghold

claims.subject: jhoira

evidence.quote: Now we raise the Weatherlight.
Between the merfolk and her human salvage crew, they had wrestled the remnant to the surface.

claims.summary: Jhoira raises the sunken Weatherlight with merfolk and a human salvage crew and begins rebuilding it.

claims.subject: nissa_revane

evidence.quote: I'm sorry, but my watch is over.

claims.summary: After Amonkhet, Nissa leaves the Gatewatch and Dominaria.

claims.subject: liliana_vess

evidence.quote: Belzenlok is here.
We need Liliana's help to destroy Bolas, and she can't do that until this last demon is dead.

claims.summary: Belzenlok is the last demon of Liliana's pact; Gideon stays on Dominaria to help her kill him.

claims.subject: belzenlok

evidence.quote: Belzenlok had supplanted the god Kuberr to gain control over the Cabal

claims.summary: Belzenlok supplanted the god Kuberr to take control of the Cabal.
claims.limitation: Narrated from Liliana's point of view.

claims.subject: belzenlok

evidence.quote: Belzenlok is worshipped here by the Cabal, a death cult.

claims.summary: Belzenlok is worshipped by the Cabal, a death cult, from its Stronghold in Urborg.

claims.subject: belzenlok

evidence.quote: Belzenlok forged it. Belzenlok slayed the elder dragon.
It's said it was the Planeswalker Dakkon Bl
he's been taking credit for every shift in Dominaria's history

claims.summary: Cultists credit Belzenlok with forging the Blackblade and slaying an elder dragon; a disciple starts to name Dakkon Blackblade instead, and Jhoira says Belzenlok takes credit for every shift in Dominaria's history.
claims.limitation: Belzenlok's claims are in-story propaganda; this pack does not resolve the forger.

claims.subject: liliana_vess

evidence.quote: instead turned him into a mindless undead monster

claims.summary: Long ago, Liliana's attempt to heal her brother Josu turned him undead.

claims.subject: liliana_vess

evidence.quote: she had fled the plane as her spark ignited

claims.summary: Liliana's spark ignited as she fled Dominaria after Josu's transformation.

claims.subject: raven_man

evidence.quote: The Raven Man had manipulated her, tricked her into performing the work

claims.summary: The Raven Man manipulated Liliana into the healing work that undid Josu.
claims.limitation: The Raven Man's identity is not established in this pack.

claims.subject: belzenlok

evidence.quote: how Belzenlok had managed to turn Josu into his lich

claims.summary: Belzenlok made Josu his lich and general in Caligo.

claims.subject: liliana_vess

evidence.quote: She gripped the Chain Veil.
The curse of the House of Vess is ended.

claims.summary: At Vess Manor, Liliana uses the Chain Veil to unmake the lich Josu and end the curse of House Vess.

claims.subject: shanna

evidence.quote: I knew your ancestor, Captain Sisay. I see you carry her sword.

claims.summary: Shanna is a descendant of Captain Sisay and carries her sword; she joins the Weatherlight crew.

claims.subject: danitha_capashen

evidence.quote: Danitha Capashen, who was distantly related to Captain Gerrard

claims.summary: Danitha Capashen is distantly related to Gerrard; she declines Jhoira's invitation.

claims.subject: urza

evidence.quote: It had been created by Urza, who had collapsed Serra's Realm into the stone.

claims.summary: Urza created the Weatherlight's Powerstone by collapsing Serra's Realm into it.

claims.subject: tiana

evidence.quote: Jhoira felt the shift in the Powerstone, the moment when it came to life again.

claims.summary: Tiana's prayer revives the inert Powerstone.

claims.subject: tiana

evidence.quote: The Weatherlight's guardian angel.

claims.summary: Tiana, an angel of Serra, realizes she is the Weatherlight's guardian angel.

claims.subject: arvad

evidence.quote: I'm Arvad, Knight of Benalia. I was captured and made a vampire.

claims.summary: Arvad is a Knight of Benalia who was captured and made a vampire.

claims.subject: weatherlight_powerstone

evidence.quote: That was Arvad, who the white star had called from across the world to be Tiana's friend and helper.

claims.summary: Arvad was drawn across the world to the ship by what Slimefoot perceives as the 'white star'.
claims.limitation: 'White star' is Slimefoot's perception; identifying it with the Powerstone is an inference.

claims.subject: slimefoot

evidence.quote: For a long time Slimefoot knew nothing except the Weatherlight's warm hull and the hot sun of Bogardan.

claims.summary: The saproling Slimefoot sprouted and grew aboard the Weatherlight.

claims.subject: venser

evidence.quote: Venser gave up his spark to Karn, to rescue him. Venser did not survive.

claims.summary: Venser gave his spark to Karn to rescue him and died.

claims.subject: ajani

evidence.quote: An entire plane has fallen to them, but they've been contained there.
Everyone I've talked to thinks the Phyrexians aren't a threat anymore, but

claims.summary: Ajani tells Jhoira the Phyrexians are contained on one fallen plane; Jaya doubts the common belief that they are no longer a threat.
claims.limitation: These are in-story assessments; later official stories show a Phyrexian threat to Dominaria.

claims.subject: blackblade

evidence.quote: It killed an elder dragon.
Piru, I think,

claims.summary: Jhoira says the Blackblade killed an elder dragon; Shanna names Piru, hedged with 'I think'.

claims.subject: blackblade

evidence.quote: it's a soul-drinker, created with death magic, and steals the life-energy of everyone it kills.

claims.summary: The Blackblade is a soul-drinker that steals the life-energy of everything it kills.

claims.subject: teferi

evidence.quote: So I created a time rift and phased Zhalfir partially out of this plane.

claims.summary: During the Phyrexian Invasion, Teferi phased Zhalfir partially out of Dominaria to spare it.

claims.subject: teferi

evidence.quote: His Planeswalker spark had been needed to repair Shiv's time rift
That's how he lost his Planeswalker spark.

claims.summary: Teferi spent his spark repairing Shiv's time rift, which left him unable to return Zhalfir.

claims.subject: niambi

evidence.quote: his daughter Niambi said

claims.summary: Niambi is Teferi's daughter.

claims.subject: niambi

evidence.quote: She had made this stone herself at the Thran Mana Rig. It held Teferi's Planeswalker spark.

claims.summary: Niambi made a Powerstone at the Thran Mana Rig that holds Teferi's spark.

claims.subject: teferi

evidence.quote: One of the reasons I took my spark back was to come with you.

claims.summary: Teferi takes his spark back to join the fight against Bolas.
claims.limitation: Ep. 11 states he took it back; that the stone in Ep. 6 is the mechanism is an inference across episodes.

claims.subject: jaya_ballard

evidence.quote: Furious, she faced Luti. Or Jaya.
Where do you think the monastery kept getting those 'long-lost writings of Jaya Ballard' from?

claims.summary: Luti, the old woman at the Keral Keep monastery, was Jaya Ballard in disguise.

claims.subject: chandra_nalaar

evidence.quote: But if I can find Jaya, I'm going to give her these

claims.summary: Chandra seeks Jaya Ballard on Dominaria to learn from her.

claims.subject: karn

evidence.quote: He's found the Sylex.
I intend to take it to New Phyrexia and detonate it there.

claims.summary: Karn excavates the Sylex and intends to detonate it on New Phyrexia.

claims.subject: rtd_sylex

evidence.quote: In his semiconscious state, he senses that the Sylex is being uncovered, brought closer to the surface, and he fears it. For good reason; it caused great damage to him.

claims.summary: The Sylex harmed Multani in the past, which implies the Golgothian Sylex of Argoth.
claims.limitation: The episode says 'the Sylex'; identity with the Golgothian Sylex is inferred.

claims.subject: rtd_sylex

evidence.quote: It was created by Urza to help defeat the Phyrexians.

claims.summary: Karn says Urza created the Sylex; Pack B (B012) preserves competing official origin legends.
claims.limitation: In-story statement by Karn; see Pack B B012.

claims.subject: multani

evidence.quote: he senses that the Sylex is being uncovered

claims.summary: A semiconscious Multani attacks the dig site, fearing the Sylex.

claims.subject: cabal_stronghold

evidence.quote: It had been created as a Phyrexian base

claims.summary: The Cabal Stronghold was first built as a Phyrexian base.

claims.subject: liliana_vess

evidence.quote: Liliana leapt forward, under Belzenlok's arm, and seized the Blackblade's hilt.
as the Blade drained Belzenlok's life

claims.summary: Gideon carries the Blackblade into the fight, and Liliana uses it to drain and kill Belzenlok.

claims.subject: belzenlok_death

evidence.quote: They had found the weapon inside the fourth treasury vault

claims.summary: The crew recovers the Blackblade from the Stronghold's fourth treasury vault before the final battle.

claims.subject: nicol_bolas

evidence.quote: The contract still controlled her, and now she belonged to an entity more vicious than any demon

claims.summary: After Belzenlok dies, Bolas reveals that Liliana's pact now binds her to him.

claims.subject: radha

evidence.quote: Radha had been a prisoner of the Cabal, but at least she was free now.

claims.summary: Radha is freed from the Cabal's prison after the Stronghold falls.

remaining: Episodes were read by targeted extraction, not exhaustively; secondary characters (Hadi, Tien, Rael, Thiago, Naban, Subira, Kwende, Urgoros, Luti's monastery) are not modelled
The Raven Man's identity is not asserted
No in-universe AR dates appear in these episodes; none are inferred
Card anchors (e.g., Blackblade Reforged, Settle the Score, In Bolas's Clutches art captions) not yet linked
